claims.claim_text_normalized: DINO achieves 49.4 AP in 12 epochs on COCO with a ResNet-50 backbone and multi-scale features.
claims.evidence_quote_short: DINO achieves 49 .4AP in 12 epochs and 51 .3AP in 24 epochs on COCO with a ResNet-50 backbone and multi-scale features

claims.claim_text_normalized: DINO yields a significant improvement of +6.0 AP compared to DN-DETR in the 12-epoch setting.
claims.evidence_quote_short: yielding a significant improvement of +6.0AP and +2.7AP, respectively, compared to DN-DETR, the previous best DETR-like model

claims.claim_text_normalized: DINO obtains the best results on COCO val2017 (63.2 AP) and test-dev (63.3 AP) after pre-training on Objects365 with a SwinL backbone.
claims.evidence_quote_short: after pre-training on the Objects365 dataset with a SwinL backbone, DINO obtains the best results on both COCO val2017 (63.2AP) and test-dev (63.3AP)

claims.claim_text_normalized: DINO reduces model size to 1/15 compared to SwinV2-G while achieving better results.
claims.evidence_quote_short: we reduce the model size to 1/15 compared to SwinV2-G [22]

claims.claim_text_normalized: Contrastive denoising training helps the model avoid duplicate outputs of the same target.
claims.evidence_quote_short: The contrastive denoising training helps the model to avoid duplicate outputs of the same target.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Mixed query selection initializes anchor boxes from encoder outputs but keeps content queries learnable.
claims.evidence_quote_short: we only initialize anchor boxes using the position information associated with the selected top-K features, but leave the content queries static as before

claims.claim_text_normalized: The look forward twice scheme passes gradients from later decoder layers to earlier layers to improve box prediction.
claims.evidence_quote_short: we propose a new look forward twice scheme to correct the updated parameters with gradients from later layers

claims.claim_text_normalized: DINO achieves a new state of the art of 63.3 AP on COCO 2017 test-dev.
claims.evidence_quote_short: achieved a new state of the art, 63 .3 AP on COCO 2017 test-dev
